body:
PR #11's scouting and verification additions had no controlled evidence separating their effects. This change retains a frozen four-way comparison over five fresh synthetic repositories: 20 bounded Codex audits and two fresh, origin-masked Codex reviewer sessions. Every attempt completed within budget; exact inputs, source hashes, activity, reports, judgments, costs and limitations are retained.

The added Scout guidance produced no better investigation choice on these compact cases and is reverted. Verification occasionally clarified refuting outcomes, but reviewers frequently preferred shorter baseline handoffs, so it is reduced to a 37-word aid in the existing Probe step. Read-only permissions, evidence vocabulary, three-finding default, and optional delegation limits remain unchanged. The exact shortened wording has not had another model trial; independent process-role review is not human validation or measured developer savings.

Evidence: [full record](evaluation/results/2026-10-17-refinements/README.md), [frozen protocol](evaluation/refinements-v1.md), [reviewer 1](evaluation/results/2026-10-17-refinements/review-1-report.md), [reviewer 2](evaluation/results/2026-10-17-refinements/review-2-report.md). The record preserves ties, mild certainty problems and a shared minor documentation miss. Previous pilot results are unchanged.

Validation: 46 full regression tests pass; all 31 new case public tests and evaluator checks pass; real skills CLI 1.7.2 installs matching final payloads for Codex and Claude Code in copy/symlink modes. CI will independently run the regression suite and Node 22.20.0/24 installation matrix.

Related: #6 and #7. Leave #6 open for a larger snapshot whose full source cannot fit the inspection budget. After merge, update both issues with evidence and close #7 on its bounded comparison/simplification acceptance criteria. No production-effectiveness or exact-wording equivalence claim is made.
title: Evaluate scouting and verification; revert Scout and simplify handoffs
